config.script:
# Dev only (owner review notes item 4): an empty dev map gives no hint how to fill it, so the page's
	# line says to seed from /edit while the map store holds no item (system.mapstudio.getMap, the
	# scripting API; a viewer may read it). The click hint is the line once items exist.
	import java.lang

	logger = system.util.getLogger('MapStudio.dev')
	title = self.rootContainer.getChild('title')
	try:
		count = len(system.mapstudio.getMap('mapstudio-dev'))
	except java.lang.Throwable as ex:
		logger.warn('Dev page item count failed: %s' % ex.getClass().getSimpleName())
		return
	except Exception as ex:
		logger.warn('Dev page item count failed: %s' % type(ex).__name__)
		return
	if count == 0:
		title.props.text = 'Map Studio: the dev map in View mode. The map has no items yet: open /edit, log in as mapeditor and press Seed the dev map; editing is on /edit.'
	else:
		title.props.text = 'Map Studio: the dev map in View mode. Click a point for its popup, a line for the line popup; editing is on /edit.'

props.text: Map Studio: the dev map in View mode.
